jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP for Banking Good to have skills: NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education We are looking for experienced SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking professionals to join our banking transformation programme. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working on SAP Banking solutions within the banking domain, preferably across implementation, configuration, integration, migration or production support engagements. SAP Core Banking is an industry-specific solution for banking clients, with key capabilities across Deposits Management, Business Partner, Loans Management and Payments. Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply, with preference given to candidates who have worked across multiple SAP Banking modules and have strong banking domain knowledge. Key SAP Banking Areas The candidate should have experience in one or more of the following: 1. Deposits Management (DM) Current Accounts and Savings Accounts Term/Time Deposits Banking product configuration Account opening and lifecycle management Interest calculation and processing Charges, fees and related account operations Deposit product migration and conversion Integration with Business Partner and Payments 2. Business Partner (FS-BP) SAP Financial Services Business Partner Customer / Business Partner creation and maintenance Business Partner roles and relationships Customer data migration BP integration with Deposits, Loans and Payments Understanding of customer lifecycle processes 3. Loans Management (LM) Retail/Commercial lending products Loan account lifecycle Loan creation and disbursement Repayment and payment schedules Interest and charges Loan closure/payoff Loan product configuration and migration Integration with Payments and Business Partner 4. Payments / Payment Central / Payment Engine Payment processing and payment lifecycle Payment initiation and processing Payment routing and distribution Payment exceptions and investigation Payment-related configuration Integration with core banking and external payment systems Understanding of domestic/international payment flows Key Responsibilities Work with business and technology teams to understand banking requirements and translate them into SAP Banking solutions. Configure and support SAP Core Banking functionality based on business requirements. Participate in end-to-end SAP Banking implementation and transformation programmes. Support product configuration across Deposits, Loans, Business Partner and Payments. Analyse existing legacy banking processes and support their migration to SAP. Support data migration, reconciliation and validation activities. Work on integration between SAP Banking modules and external banking applications. Analyse and resolve functional issues, defects and production incidents. Support SIT, UAT, regression testing and production deployment activities. Work closely with technical teams on interfaces, APIs, integrations and batch processing. Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios and operational documentation. Participate in design discussions and provide banking domain expertise. Support release planning, implementation and post-go-live activities. Collaborate with distributed teams across business, technology, vendors and banking stakeholders. Required Skills Must Have: Hands-on experience in SAP Banking / SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking. Strong understanding of banking products and processes. Experience in at least one of the following: Deposits Management Loans Management Business Partner / FS-BP Payments / Payment Engine / Payment Central Experience in SAP Banking implementation, migration, configuration or production support. Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking components. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders. Preferred Skills Candidates with experience across two or more of the following will be preferred: SAP Deposits Management SAP Loans Management SAP Financial Services Business Partner SAP Payment Engine / Payments SAP Transactional Banking / TRBK SAP Banking Services Banking product configuration Legacy-to-SAP banking migration Large-scale banking transformation programmes Retail Banking / Corporate Banking Account and customer migration Banking payments and settlement processes Banking Domain Experience Candidates should have a good understanding of one or more of the following banking processes: Current and Savings Accounts Term Deposits Customer / Business Partner lifecycle Loans and lending products Account opening and closure Interest and fee processing Payments and payment processing Account migration Customer migration Product migration Banking reconciliation Payment exceptions and investigations Integration & Technical Exposure Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking and surrounding systems is desirable. Exposure to the following would be advantageous: APIs / Web Services REST / SOAP Enterprise integration Banking middleware Batch processing Data migration tools Database / SQL SAP integration frameworks Legacy banking platforms Payment systems Experience in Transformation / Migration Experience in large-scale banking transformation programmes will be highly valuable, particularly: Legacy banking platform SAP migration Customer and account migration Deposit product migration Loan migration Payment migration Data reconciliation and validation Application decommissioning Parallel run / cutover Production deployment and hypercare Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a SAP Banking specialist with strong banking domain knowledge, rather than a generic SAP consultant. Qualification 15 years full time education 5-10 Yrs DNS, Commercial, Processing, Migration, Banking Product, Lending, Data, Corporate banking

jobs.title: Generative AI Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: We are looking for a talented Generative AI Engineer to join our AI innovation team at EaseMyTrip.com and help power the next generation of intelligent travel experiences. In this role, you will lead the integration and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create conversational travel agents that can understand, recommend, and assist travelers across platforms. You will work at the intersection of backend systems, AI models, and natural language understanding, bringing smart automation to every travel interaction. Key Responsibilities: LLM Integration: Deploy and integrate LLMs (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, Mistral) to process natural language queries and deliver personalized travel recommendations. Prompt Engineering & RAG: Design optimized prompts and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows to enhance contextual relevance in multi-turn conversations. Conversational Flow Design: Build and manage robust conversational workflows capable of handling complex travel scenarios such as booking modifications and cancellations. LLM Performance Optimization: Tune models and workflows to balance performance, scalability, latency, and cost across diverse environments. Backend Development: Develop scalable, asynchronous backend services using FastAPI or Django, with a focus on secure and efficient API architectures. Database & ORM Design: Design and manage data using PostgreSQL or MongoDB, and implement ORM solutions like SQLAlchemy for seamless data interaction. Cloud & Serverless Infrastructure: Deploy solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure using containerized and serverless tools such as Lambda and Cloud Functions. Model Fine-Tuning & Evaluation: Fine-tune open-source and proprietary LLMs using techniques like LoRA and PEFT, and evaluate outputs using BLEU, ROUGE, or similar metrics. NLP Pipeline Implementation: Develop NLP functionalities including named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and dialogue state tracking. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, frontend developers, and product teams to ship impactful features rapidly and iteratively. Preferred Candidate Profile: Experience: Minimum 2 years in backend development with at least 1 year of hands-on experience working with LLMs or NLP systems. Programming Skills: Proficient in Python with practical exposure to asynchronous programming and frameworks like FastAPI or Django. LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with tools and libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Database Knowledge: Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance optimization. Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models. Cloud Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and building serverless or containerized deployments. NLP Understanding: Solid grasp of NLP concepts including intent detection, dialogue management, and text classification. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach. Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Curiosity and Drive: Passionate about staying at the forefront of AI and using emerging technologies to build innovative travel experiences. 1-4 Yrs Artificial Intelligence, LLM, Conversational Ai, OpenAI, Python, Database Design, Serverless Architecture, Sentiment Analysis

jobs.title: Associate Principal Engineer (AI Solution Architect)
jobs.description: Company Description We're Nagarro. We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We're looking for great new colleagues. That's where you come in! Job Description REQUIREMENTS: Total experience 10+ years. Must have experience to design, build and run GenAI and Agentic AI solutions inside enterprise systems, fitting AI into existing systems, security rules and budgets. Must have ability to translate ambiguous business problems into durable technical architectures. Must have strong ML fundamentals; how models are trained, tested and compared; spotting overfitting and weak data, deep learning basics; embeddings, classification, ranking models Should have experience with data and feature preparation; cleaning data and choosing the inputs a model learns from. Should have experience in software engineering, with strong depth in Python. Must have experience to develop microservices and APIs (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) to embed AI and deep learning models into enterprise applications. Must have experience with GenAI and RAG design Document chunking, retrieval and ranking, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), LLM selection, prompting Should be able to architect and implement scalable ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents) aligned with business objectives. Should have exposure to building with coding agents, spec-first prompting, generated tests, careful code review Should have experience in Agent design, choosing between fixed workflows and autonomous agents, tool design (e.g., MCP), context and memory design, multi-agent patterns. Agent control and safety permissions, human approval for risky actions, limits on steps and spend, failure handling, audit trails Should have exposure to AI evaluation; Eval sets, Test sets, task-level agent testing, regression testing, measuring accuracy, speed and cost Should be able to build robust end-to-end AI pipelines and integrate Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) for data processing and feature extraction. Should be able to leverage emerging AI research to continuously fine tune models, optimize codebases, and manage scalable compute resources. Must have experience to deploy secure, production-grade hybrid and cloud AI solutions (AWS/GCP/Azure) using modern CI/CD, AI-assisted code optimization, tracing, cost tracking, versioning, rollback and strict access control. Should have strong technical communication to clearly design documents, plain-language explanations for non-technical audiences Should be able to mentor junior engineers, drive agile workflows (Jira), and partner with Product managers to define technical strategy. Should have strong grasp of AI Governance & Responsible AI, Multi-cloud AI platform architecture, AgentOps / GenAIOps, Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Layer Architecture. Should have excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical leadership. RESPONSIBILITIES: Understanding the clients business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements. Lead the design and implementation of complex GenAI workflows that combine LLMs, tools, APIs, structured data, and user context. Establish engineering standards and best practices for prompt design, model integration, evaluation, and observability. Drive GenAI platform building reusable components, SDKs, and frameworks used across multiple teams or products. Partner with product, design, data, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions. Review critical designs and codebases, unblock teams on complex technical challenges, and raise the overall engineering bar. Lead technical discovery and solutioning for high-impact initiatives, including client or executive-facing workshops when required. Ensure enterprise readiness: security, privacy, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices. Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers. Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the client’s requirements. Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high-level design of the application for the developers Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed. Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
